jobs.name: Dúo Vice
jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / product-mockup recoloring. Input1 is the EXACT final Dúo Vice hoodie photograph to edit. Input2 is ONLY a fabric COLOR authority, ignore its Barista words and graphic.
CHANGE ONLY THE GARMENT FABRIC COLOR from pastel pink to clear rich royal BLUE #2455B8, same fabric shade as the supplied existing store blue hoodie; not cyan, not navy. Preserve the exact person/pose/back view, garment construction, seams, cuffs and hood and black trousers, textile volume and shadows. Keep background and camera EXACTLY the same: dark technology studio, soft cyan left and magenta right, neutral softbox on fabric. Entire complete single product in same frame; SQUARE 1:1. Do not change the person, hair, hands, pose or front/back view.
KEEP THE PRINTED ARTWORK unchanged: same artwork shapes, exact composition, colors, placement and proportions; main exact text "grand", "theft", "auto", "VI". All graphic details must remain recognizable and legible; no redraw, replacement slogan, added technical label, icons, barcode, watermark, UI or new objects. Preserve sunset colors and dark outlines inside the print. If contrast against a dark fabric is low, preserve its existing pale keyline rather than recoloring the design. No tinted filter over whole photograph, no recoloring skin, ink or stand. Photorealistic product catalog variant; ONE final image.
